reason: The cold packs need recharging, and the powered freezer is the natural place to do it.
expectation: I expect the freezer to restore the packs' cold-transfer capacity.

alternatives.reason: Restarting propellant production also addresses a goal, but I chose to recharge the cold reserve first.

effect: The cold-transfer reserve is recharged, leaving the propellant production goal.
reaction: The result was expected and reassuring.
reason: Restarting the plant is the remaining goal and the only gameplay action offered.
expectation: I expect solar power to restart propellant production, though I don't know whether another step will be needed.

effect: The return plant is running, completing the remaining goal for this chapter.
reaction: The result was expected; I was curious whether restarting production would require more work.

mostWorthwhile.text: Recharging the cold packs was the most worthwhile action because it restored the transfer reserve used to protect the frozen core.

leastWorthwhile.text: Restarting the plant felt brief: the result confirmed it was running without showing much about the restart.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me; both actions produced the expected results.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary: the freezer and restart controls clearly matched the stated goals.

continue.text: I would continue because I want to see how the preserved discovery reaches Earth, though this chapter's two straightforward actions offered little decision-making.
